takeaway: Duolingo draws fierce, well-documented criticism across Trustpilot, Reddit, PissedConsumer, the App Store, and Sitejabber — chiefly around its aggressive monetization shift (the new Energy system replacing Hearts), opaque billing/subscription traps, near-zero human customer support, and shallow learning depth. App-store star ratings remain high (4.5–4.7) but review-site scores are low (1.7 Trustpilot, 2.2 PissedConsumer), signalling a vocal dissatisfied minority that skews paying and long-term users.

issues.title: Energy System Seen as a Paywall That Blocks Free Learning
issues.gist: New Energy mechanic drains faster than Hearts, forcing ads, gem spend, or paid upgrade just to finish a session.

evidence.quote: "lessons cost energy even when perfect, and once it's gone you're stuck"
"the new energy bar update may made many users to quit Duolingo"
"increasingly aggressive monetization that restricts learning for free users"

issues.title: Billing Traps & Unauthorized Subscription Charges
issues.gist: Free-trial auto-renewals into annual plans catch users off guard; refunds are deflected to Apple with no direct resolution.

evidence.quote: "charged through my Apple account for the entire year … out not only $95"
"shady billing practices and some of the worst customer service I've ever experienced"
"Frequent customer complaints about billing, unauthorized charges, and refund delays"

issues.title: Customer Support Is Effectively Non-Existent
issues.gist: Only ~2 full-time support staff for millions of users; Reddit mods revolted against serving as unpaid help desk.

evidence.quote: "the company maintains only two regular, full-time support staff members"
"no customer service, poor billing and refund handling"
"I have been trying to contact Duolingo for two months and have not received a response"

issues.title: Shallow Pedagogy: Gamification Replaces Real Learning
issues.gist: Rote drills and XP-chasing dominate; little grammar instruction means users plateau after beginner level.

evidence.quote: "565-day streak … my French is nul! The app just throws random sentences"
"lessons have no bearing on real world situations"
"eventually you start playing the game to win points rather than to learn"

issues.title: Speech Recognition & Audio Bugs Undermine Speaking Practice
issues.gist: Microphone fails to detect short words or quiet speech; audio playback cuts off, frustrating speaking exercises.

evidence.quote: "It doesn't detect short words well … playbacks also cut off the first or last part"
"the microphone won't listen … you gotta say the sentence way louder"
"lost access to respond/repeat answers … no longer have access to the microphone"

love: Highly accessible free tier with 40+ languages and a genuinely fun, habit-forming gamified loop praised by hundreds of millions of users
Bite-sized lessons, instant feedback, and streak mechanics are widely credited with keeping casual learners consistently engaged
App Store ratings remain stellar (4.7 iOS / 4.5 Android), and new offerings like Chess course are growing rapidly with 7M+ daily active users

actions.action: Redesign the Energy system to guarantee a meaningful daily free session (e.g., at least 3 full lessons) before ads or energy gates kick in
actions.why: The Energy paywall is the single loudest complaint across every platform in 2025–2026; easing it reduces churn and competitive pressure from free AI tools like ChatGPT

actions.action: Add clear, in-app cancellation flow and proactive pre-renewal email 7 days before any trial converts to a paid plan
actions.why: Unauthorized charge complaints are driving 1-star reviews and regulatory risk; transparent billing is the fastest way to defuse billing-related Trustpilot/PissedConsumer damage

actions.action: Staff up human customer support to at least a 1:50,000 subscriber ratio and publish a tracked SLA for ticket resolution
actions.why: Reddit mods publicly revolted and withdrew community support; Duolingo is hemorrhaging goodwill by routing paying users into a void — this is a retention and PR risk

actions.action: Introduce structured grammar-tip cards and contextual explanation tooltips (free tier) rather than locking 'Explain My Answer' behind Duolingo Max
actions.why: The pedagogy depth gap is the primary reason serious learners defect to competitors; giving free users some grammar context materially improves learning outcomes and reduces churn to Babbel/ChatGPT
